prompt:
Log type: Windows Security event log (XmlWinEventLog:Security), index=wineventlog.
Sample:
<Event><System><EventID>4625</EventID><Computer>WS-0142.corp.local</Computer><TimeCreated SystemTime='2026-11-20T08:14:02Z'/></System><EventData><Data Name='TargetUserName'>jdoe</Data><Data Name='IpAddress'>10.20.4.17</Data><Data Name='LogonType'>3</Data><Data Name='Status'>0xC000006D</Data></EventData></Event>
Requirement: detect brute force - more than 10 failed logons for the same account from the same source IP within 5 minutes.
reference: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 | bin _time span=5m | stats count min(_time) as first max(_time) as last by _time TargetUserName IpAddress Computer | where count>10 | rename TargetUserName as Account IpAddress as Source_IP Computer as Device | eval Time=strftime(first,"%F %T"), SAFE_name="N/A" | table Time Account Device Source_IP SAFE_name count. Must flag SAFE_name as not present in Windows logs.

prompt:
Log type: Linux /var/log/secure (sourcetype=linux_secure), index=os_linux.
Sample:
Nov 20 08:15:11 bastion01 sshd[22871]: Failed password for invalid user admin from 203.0.113.50 port 51234 ssh2
Requirement: SIEM query for failed SSH logins, map to baseline fields.
reference: Use rex to extract user and src from 'Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)'; Device=host; flag SAFE_name missing.

prompt:
Log type: CyberArk Vault syslog in CEF (sourcetype=cyberark:epv:cef), index=pam.
Sample:
CEF:0|Cyber-Ark|Vault|12.6|295|Retrieve password|5|act=Retrieve password suser=svc_backup fname=Root\\Operating System-WinDomain-corp.local-admin01 dvc=10.1.1.5 shost=10.30.2.44 dhost=SRV-DB01 cs2Label=Safe Name cs2=WIN-ADMINS-PROD
Requirement: detect password retrievals from the WIN-ADMINS-PROD safe outside business hours (before 07:00 or after 19:00).
reference: index=pam sourcetype=cyberark:epv:cef act="Retrieve password" cs2="WIN-ADMINS-PROD" | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | where hour<7 OR hour>=19 | eval Time=_time, Account=suser, Device=dhost, Source_IP=shost, SAFE_name=cs2 | table Time Account Device Source_IP SAFE_name act

prompt:
This query errors with 'Unbalanced quotes'. Fix it:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 | eval Account=TargetUserName, Source_IP=IpAddress | search Account!="*$ | stats count by Account Source_IP
reference: Missing closing quote in Account!="*$"; corrected: ... | search Account!="*$" | stats count by Account Source_IP

prompt:
Why does this fail and how do I fix it?
index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic | tstats count where index=network by src_ip
reference: tstats is a generating command and must be first: | tstats count where index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic by src_ip. Mention it only works on indexed fields (src_ip may need a data model: from datamodel=Network_Traffic, All_Traffic.src).

prompt:
Fix this:
index=proxy sourcetype=bluecoat | stats count by | sort -count
reference: stats ... by needs a field, e.g. stats count by src or by url; explain the error.

prompt:
This is very slow on 30 days of data, can you optimize it?
index=vpn sourcetype=cisco:asa | transaction user maxspan=8h startswith="Login" endswith="Logout" | eval session_min=duration/60 | table user session_min
reference: Replace transaction with stats: | stats min(_time) as start max(_time) as end by user, session id; compute duration=(end-start)/60. Filter Login/Logout events in base search.

prompt: Business requirement: a traceability dashboard for privileged account usage from CyberArk (index=pam sourcetype=cyberark:epv:cef). Need KPIs for daily retrievals per safe, top accounts, and retrievals outside business hours. Give me panel queries.
reference: At least 3 panels: timechart span=1d count by SAFE_name; top/stats by Account; off-hours count. Suggest visualizations.

prompt:
Explain what this does, step by step:
index=web sourcetype=access_combined status>=500 | rex field=uri "^/api/(?<api_version>v\d+)/(?<endpoint>[^/?]+)" | stats count dc(clientip) as unique_clients by api_version endpoint | where count > 100
reference: Filters 5xx, extracts api_version and endpoint, counts errors and distinct clients per endpoint, keeps endpoints with >100 errors.

prompt: Using the CIM Authentication data model (accelerated), write a fast detection for one source IP failing authentication against more than 20 distinct accounts in 1 hour (password spraying).
reference: | tstats summariesonly=true dc(Authentication.user) as users from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.src _time span=1h | where users>20 | rename Authentication.* as *
